They preferred a rubber sanding block for curved surfaces and noted that sandpaper should be kept clean and replaced as needed; no completion was reported.

They also asked for easy-to-digest snack ideas. No later outcome was reported.

They had been exploring indie rock, electronic music, and hip-hop and listening repeatedly to Tame Impala’s The Slow Rush. They considered local lessons, planned separate Guitar Inspiration and Guitar Goals playlists, and thought recording and reviewing their playing could help identify improvements; no later progress was recorded.

GreenCycle’s social-media planning: by 2023-05-12, the user ran the sustainable-products online store and had been posting several times weekly on Instagram, Facebook, and Pinterest. Goals were website traffic, brand awareness, and customer engagement; preferred content included product showcases, behind-the-scenes posts, craft-fair products, and sustainability education. The user wanted at least three posts weekly per platform but was open to adjustment, was unsure about Facebook Live, and wanted to track traffic and engagement while treating follower growth as secondary. They attended a local craft fair shortly before 2023-05-12 and networked with small-business owners.

They especially liked behind-the-scenes and product-showcase posts for a joint Summer Fest stall campaign with friend Emily; the Summer Fest year and dates were unspecified.
